lever.change: Harden the probe author in qnfo-fleet-control/worker.js ONLY (functions rtProbeAuthorValidSql, rtAuthorLivePathProbe and their constants), keeping every existing behaviour of #4401: (1) PRIVACY (doctrine section 9, personal/research separation): a model-authored probe may read only operational tables. Implement a deny rule for private data that FAILS CLOSED: reject any table whose name matches a private family (mail/email/inbox/message/thread, contact, subscriber, identity, owner_ prefix tables that hold documents, personal, credential/token/secret/key, session (login), chat/conversation, outreach, suppression, calendar, draft) AND require every referenced table to be in an allowlist derived at run time from the tables the fleet's existing active d1-query contracts already probe (SELECT of distinct table names from remediation_contracts.verify_probe is not possible in SQL alone: instead keep a code constant of operational tables and verify it against live sqlite_master in the test, so the constant cannot name a private table). The prompt must not list private tables, and the stored probe text, the dry-run observed value and the decision_log evidence are truncated (probe <= 600 chars, observed <= 200). Include table names reached through a subquery, join, CTE, comma-join and quoted/bracketed identifiers in the static scan. (2) SELF-CONFIRMING PROBES: reject a probe that can flip to ok because of the author's own writes or the loop's own bookkeeping: it must not read decision_log, remediation_contracts, remediation_verifications, v_remediation_evidence_all, issue_triage, issue_lifecycle, agent_issues for any row other than via the fixed forms the existing code already allows, cloud_ops_events rows of kind remediation.probe-authored / remediation.probe-author-reject / remediation.probe-needed-filed, nor the target issue's own contract class. (3) DEFERRAL SHAPE: a probe whose dry-run observed value starts with 'pending' (case-insensitive) or is empty is rejected, because the verification engine treats 'pending' as a deferral (rtIsDeferral): the contract could never fail or pass. Also reject observed values that equal the string 'ok' when expected is not 'ok' is NOT required; keep the existing expected<>observed vacuity gate. Every new reject writes the existing remediation.probe-author-reject event with an enum reason code (private-table, self-confirming, deferral-shape, not-allowlisted, too-long) and never the probe text itself. Add tests to qnfo-fleet-control/probe-author.test.mjs (private tables of every family rejected incl. subquery/join/quoted forms; self-confirming forms rejected; pending and empty observed rejected; a legitimate operational probe still accepted end to end with a fake env.AI; the constant allowlist checked against a fixture sqlite_master that mirrors live names). The change is in CM_LOOP_CANARIED scope; bump VERSION as a PATCH strictly above main and every open PR (the doctor engine PR will take a minor above yours: do not use 0.51.0), keep deployed-current.worker.js identical, release note per VERSION-LINE-NOTES-1. Do not touch the doctor block, other workers or migrations.
lever.closing_probe: SELECT 'ok' AS expected, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events WHERE kind='remediation.probe-author-reject' AND ts > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-1 day') AND text LIKE '%private-table%' OR kind='remediation.probe-authored') THEN 'ok' ELSE 'no authored probe or typed reject yet' END AS observed
